decisions.reason: As a more niche men's-care line with only limited visible follow-up and weaker integration into the core range, management in 2022 is relatively likely to end it rather than keep justifying a modestly committed launch.

Because the cleansing foam was launched as an extension of the existing Sandorini series and sits very close to the firm's core natural-skincare offer, management is more likely to continue it and justify the prior launch commitment.
